what: Mistake: my 'keep a batch running' request asked for two things at once (skip a failing item, and sort repeated failures by shared cause). The plan grew from 15 to 22 steps, the writer ran out of time, and the batch stopped again on the same bug. Replaced with a one-change request.
why: Requests that bundle a fix with a reclassification grow past one job; the smallest change would have landed
